astextract generic.go
cmp stdout generic.stdout

-- generic.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func Sum[T int | int64 | float64](a, b T) T {
    return a + b
}

type Pair[T any] struct {
    First, Second T
}

func main() {
    fmt.Println(Sum(3, 4))
    p := Pair[string]{First: "hello", Second: "world"}
    fmt.Println(p.First, p.Second)
}
